meta.scope: UAE Batch 1 — Phase 0/1 foundations under locked expanded node definition. Federal Competitiveness and Statistics Centre (FCSC), population, national accounts, CPI, Central Bank of the UAE (CBUAE) institutional core, BOP. Population ~10 million. Diversified hydrocarbon + services + logistics structure.

candidates.title: Federal Competitiveness and Statistics Centre (FCSC) institutional core
candidates.description: Primary federal statistical office responsible for national accounts, prices, demographic, social and multi-domain statistics, and coordination with emirate-level statistical centres.
candidates.notes: Foundational institutional node for the UAE federal statistical system.

candidates.title: Population estimates
candidates.description: Official population estimates. Population is approximately 10 million; the structure includes a large majority of non-nationals and high urban concentration in Dubai and Abu Dhabi.
candidates.notes: Core demographic node. Population ~10 million; expatriate-majority structure.

candidates.title: National Accounts of the UAE (GDP)
candidates.description: Official national accounts (GDP). The economy combines hydrocarbon production (concentrated in Abu Dhabi) with a large diversified non-oil services, logistics, tourism and finance base (concentrated in Dubai and other emirates).
candidates.notes: Primary macroeconomic output node. Dual hydrocarbon + diversified structure.

candidates.title: Consumer Price Index and inflation statistics
candidates.description: CPI and inflation rates. Inflation has generally been moderate under the dirham peg and active demand management.

candidates.title: Central Bank of the UAE (CBUAE) institutional and reporting core
candidates.description: Central bank responsible for monetary policy, the dirham peg, foreign-exchange reserves management, banking supervision and key macro-financial and external statistics. Publishes monetary, banking, BOP and related series.
candidates.notes: Central-bank institutional counterpart to FCSC. Dirham peg is the monetary anchor.

candidates.title: Balance of Payments and external accounts
candidates.description: BOP and external-sector statistics. Large current-account surpluses are structural, driven by hydrocarbon and services exports; significant net acquisition of external financial assets is a persistent feature.
candidates.notes: External-accounts node under surplus and asset-accumulation structure.

candidates.title: UAE foundational statistical-system meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from FCSC and CBUAE sources
candidates.description: Meta-node binding the FCSC institutional core, population, national accounts, CPI, CBUAE institutional role and BOP into the opening foundation layer for UAE research.
referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
candidates.notes: Opening integrating node. Hydrocarbon + diversified services/logistics structure will guide subsequent densification.
